Fix only still-valid concrete bugs, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. Skip Decision required, policy forks, and "consider X" alternatives. Do not add new features, refactors, or architecture beyond the fix; prefer the smallest diff. Findings to address: 1. In `@apps/desktop/src/styles.css` (line 3516, Important): `:root:not(.dark) .btn-ghost[class]` (specificity 0,4,0) forces `color: #0058c2` on every `.btn-ghost` in light mode, and it beats single-class utilities such as `.text-red-400`. `apps/desktop/src/ui/plugins-smart.js:140` renders the destructive `Delete` button as `btn-ghost text-2xs text-red-400`, so in light mode it renders as a blue link-like button instead of red. Any other `btn-ghost` that carries a semantic text color class will be recolored the same way. Scope the override to the ghost buttons that should be blue (e.g. a dedicated class or `:not([class*="text-"])`), or exclude the danger variant explicitly. ```

**Actionable comments posted: 2** > [!CAUTION] > Some comments are outside the diff and can’t be posted inline due to GitHub limitations. > > **⚠️ Outside diff range comments (1)** > >
> Minor · Convert drag measurements to CSS pixels before snapping. · sidebar.js:147
>
>
>
> > `apps/desktop/src/ui/sidebar.js:147` > ** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** > > **Convert drag measurements to CSS pixels before snapping.** > > The body scales by `--ui-scale`, so `getBoundingClientRect()` returns rendered pixels. The pointer delta is also in rendered pixels. The clamp bounds and the written `--sidebar-drag-w` value are CSS pixels. At a scale such as 0.8, a 9 px inward drag can collapse a 160 CSS px sidebar, and the sidebar shrinks faster than the pointer moves. Divide the start width and the pointer delta by the scale so that all drag values use CSS pixels. > >
> Suggested fix >
>
>
> > ```diff > /** @type {{ startX: number, startW: number, rtl: boolean, moved: boolean, min: number, max: number } | null} */ > + /** @type {{ startX: number, startW: number, rtl: boolean, moved: boolean, min: number, max: number, scale: number } | null} */ > ``` > > ```diff > const onDown = (e) => { > if (e.button !== 0) return; > e.preventDefault(); > const rtl = getComputedStyle(nav).direction === 'rtl'; > + const scale = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--ui-scale')) || 1; > drag = { > startX: e.clientX, > - startW: nav.getBoundingClientRect().width, > + startW: nav.getBoundingClientRect().width / scale, > rtl, > moved: false, > + scale, > min: cssPx('--sidebar-w-collapsed', COLLAPSED_W), > max: cssPx('--sidebar-w-expanded', EXPANDED_W), > }; > ``` > > ```diff > - const dx = (e.clientX - drag.startX) * (drag.rtl ? -1 : 1); > + const dx = (e.clientX - drag.startX) * (drag.rtl ? -1 : 1) / drag.scale; > ``` > >
>
